title: Helensvale QLD - nbn network upgrade
current_summary:
Affects an nbn service in Helensvale QLD. The maintenance window runs from 12:00 am to 6:00 am AEST on Tuesday 1 December 2026, with a single outage of up to 120 minutes expected, starting at 12:00 am.

nbn is upgrading equipment and software on the cable (HFC) network in your area. Your internet service will drop out once during the window, for up to 2 hours, and should not change in speed or performance afterwards.

This change involves a combined update on Cable Modem Termination Systems (CMTS) to support nbn's ongoing evolution of the HFC network from a Centralised Access Architecture (CAA) to a Dynamic Access Architecture (DAA) model. The works include enabling Precision Time Protocol (PTP) by transitioning the clock source from an internal oscillator to an external PTP network, along with the application of an R13 software patch on the CMTS.These activities are part of a network-level improvement program designed to increase resilience and prepare the HFC network for future upgrades. To minimise overall customer impact, the PTP enablement and R13 patch upgrade have been combined into a single planned maintenance event.During the scheduled work window, customers may experience a single outage of up to 120 minutes. As this is a network-level change, there is no expected immediate change to individual service performance once services are restored.

nbn is completing a remote software update on your nbn-branded equipment. This will cause your nbn® service to briefly lose connection. 

If your connection does not come back after the listed outage date and times, try turning your nbn connection box off at the power point, waiting 30 seconds, then switching it on again.
